# Fixtures for `s57` (S-57 / S-101 nautical charts)

Files made for whiff's tests for a fictitious harbour (Saltmere Harbour), CC0-1.0 unless the table says otherwise. Regenerate with `scripts/fixtures/geo.sh`.

| File | Origin | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `SM5HARB1.000` | ogr2ogr -f S57 (GDAL 3.10; feature records only) | CC0-1.0 |
| `US5OR2XF.000` | NOAA electronic navigational chart US5OR2XF (charts.noaa.gov) | Public domain (US Government work) |
| `US5WA4KT.000` | NOAA electronic navigational chart US5WA4KT (charts.noaa.gov) | Public domain (US Government work) |
